title: Compute characteristic dimensionless parameters
action: Using water property values (saturated vapor pressure P_s=3.6e3 Pa, latent heat L0=43.8 kJ/mol, density rho=997 kg/m^3, diffusion coefficient D=0.25 cm^2/s, condensation coefficient alpha_c=0.04, surface tension sigma=71 mN/m, ambient temperature T0=300 K, and Boltzmann constant k) and the definitions of the diffusion-heat coupled model, compute the dimensionless parameter a, characteristic length b (nm), characteristic time tau (microseconds), and surface tension parameter beta. Write a JSON file with these four values.
description: Characteristic dimensionless and dimensional parameters of the model for water.
output_schema: JSON object with keys: a (dimensionless), b (nm), tau (microseconds), beta (dimensionless).

title: Compute psychrometric temperature
action: For water at T0=300 K and ambient humidities f0=0.9 and 0.99, compute the steady-state psychrometric relative temperature difference z_inf (limit R → ∞) using the diffusion-heat coupled model. Write a CSV with columns f0, z_inf.
description: Psychrometric temperature difference for two near-saturation humidity values.
output_schema: CSV with columns: f0 (float), z_inf (float). Two rows: f0=0.9 and 0.99.

title: Compute droplet lifetime table
action: Implement the analytical lifetime formula from the diffusion-heat coupled model for water at T0=300 K, f0=0.5, alpha_c=0.04. Compute the complete evaporation time theta for a set of initial radii R_initial ranging from 0.01 to 100 micrometers (at least 20 logarithmically spaced points). Write a CSV with columns R_initial_um, lifetime_s.
description: Complete evaporation time as a function of initial droplet radius.
output_schema: CSV with columns: R_initial_um (float, micrometers), lifetime_s (float, seconds). At least 20 rows covering the range 0.01 to 100 µm.
